rules: All source tasks complete and integrated before P1-GATE; formal test work cannot start before that gate.
dependsOn controls start; integrationNeeds controls final integration, not premature functional tests.
Execution-state tasks use immutable plan IDs and bind actual owner/paths/status/evidence; plan itself is not an execution report.
P1-INTEGRATE leases shared files only after workers release them; never concurrent broad src ownership.
P4 failure preserves run, returns to affected P3 fixes, then validates a new full candidate; no cross-candidate report splicing.
P5 candidate-affecting edits require returning to P4. Publishing requires actual session authorization.
